name: Job Hunt
install:
set -euo pipefail

if ! command -v pdftotext >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends poppler-utils
fi

if ! command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo ln -sf "$(command -v python3)" /usr/local/bin/python
fi

python3 -m pip install --user reportlab pypdf

mkdir -p output

link_rel() {
  local dest="$1"
  local rel="$2"
  local src="$3"
  if [ -e "$dest" ] || [ -L "$dest" ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  if [ -f "$src" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"
    ln -sfn "$rel" "$dest"
  fi
}

link_rel config/master_profile.md ../master_profile.md master_profile.md
link_rel config/job_preferences.md ../job_preferences.md job_preferences.md
link_rel config/application_rules.md ../application_rules.md application_rules.md
link_rel config/job_scoring.md ../job_scoring.md job_scoring.md
link_rel config/resume_tailoring.md ../resume_tailoring.md resume_tailoring.md
link_rel config/answer_bank.md ../answer_bank.md answer_bank.md
link_rel config/red_flags.md ../red_flags.md red_flags.md
link_rel config/site_policy.md ../site_policy.md site_policy.md
link_rel config/target_config_block.md ../target_config_block.md target_config_block.md
link_rel config/mcp_setup.md ../mcp_setup.md mcp_setup.md
link_rel config/runtime.md ../runtime.md runtime.md
link_rel data/application_tracker.csv ../application_tracker.csv application_tracker.csv
link_rel prompts/daily_automation_prompt.md ../daily_automation_prompt.md daily_automation_prompt.md
link_rel templates/daily_report.md ../daily_report.md daily_report.md
link_rel .cursor/rules/job-application-agent.mdc ../../job-application-agent.mdc job-application-agent.mdc
link_rel reference/Karina_Rohra_Digital_Marketing_Resume_FINAL.pdf ../Karina_Rohra_Digital_Marketing_Resume_FINAL.pdf Karina_Rohra_Digital_Marketing_Resume_FINAL.pdf
link_rel reference/README.txt ../README.txt README.txt

if [ ! -f scripts/validate_config.py ] && [ -f validate_config.py ]; then
  mkdir -p scripts
  cp validate_config.py scripts/validate_config.py
fi
if [ ! -f scripts/build_resume_pdf.py ] && [ -f build_resume_pdf.py ]; then
  mkdir -p scripts
  cp build_resume_pdf.py scripts/build_resume_pdf.py
fi

test -f config/master_profile.md
test -f config/runtime.md
test -f data/application_tracker.csv
test -f scripts/validate_config.py
test -f scripts/build_resume_pdf.py
python3 -c "import reportlab, pypdf"
echo "job-hunt workspace ready"
